scope: Read-only, bounded review of existing bare handlebar and instruments candidates, actual documentary photographs and existing renders. No other motorcycle geometry reviewed.
method: Eleven native image files actually opened. Source construction/parameters and existing reports read; source hashes match Blender render reports. No Blender process, new render, model, catalogue, registry or Git change for this audit.

analytical_crop.purpose: Read speed ticks, warning symbol and nested USB surround without changing photographic information

supported_observations: Instrument functions/handedness are correct at this review level: speed0–140 and odometer left; fuelE/F and gear1–5 right. No tachometer/speed confusion was found.
USB is now rounded and bears a moulded symbol; the initial cubic cap with inventedUSB word is an obsolete defect and is not reasserted.
The user-requestedWEWA replacement is intentional, not a reference discrepancy to undo.
Bare handlebar has a continuous bright tube, raised bends and two centre bands; these broad features exist in related isolated photographs. Exact sweep/rise/radius are not established.

visible_findings.observation: The reference USB region has nested shapes: a relatively flat capsule face/lip inside a contoured stepped base with side shoulders. The candidate shows an exposed smooth oval/domed cap on a broad smooth backing. Rounded replacement improved the old block, but has not reproduced the inset lip and surround structure.
visible_findings.not_claimed: No exact width ratio, cap depth or hidden connector dimension is inferred; lens/camera remain uncalibrated.
visible_findings.next_correction: Future instrumentsv2: annotate separate outer base, inset capsule lip and cap-face contours in the official photograph before rebuilding each section. Keep the closed connector hidden, and compare the cap alone before reintegration.

visible_findings.observation: Native reference cap bears a vertical rectangular/pouch-like outline containing an oblique/zigzag marking. No three-branchedUSB trident is resolved there. The current candidate instead bears an inventedUSB trident.
visible_findings.not_claimed: Exact charging/phone/battery meaning is not established. The assembly being aUSB feature does not identify the pictured moulded glyph.
visible_findings.next_correction: Redraw the visible rectangular outer motif and inner oblique marks as original vectors; do not reuse a genericUSB icon as documentary fact.

visible_findings.observation: The reference red warning icon includes a central exclamation stroke. The candidate displays only an empty triangular outline.
visible_findings.next_correction: Add original vector stroke/dot content matching the observed warning symbol; inspect at actual user-view size.

visible_findings.observation: The reference speed dial has a conspicuous stepped/broken orange-and-white band near the upper inner arc and prominent tapered orange major marks. The candidate uses mostly thin radial ticks and simple continuous-colour arc segments, so the dial artwork reads differently even though its numbers/functions are recognisable.
visible_findings.not_claimed: No corrected per-number angle or speed/needle calibration is declared from this non-matched projection.
visible_findings.next_correction: For instrumentsv2, reconstruct visible dial bands and major-mark footprints as original vector geometry from annotated image-space shapes; resolve camera/face projection before changing numeric angular placement.

visible_findings.observation: The existing844x390 capture shows only UI on a dark background; no instrument model is visible. It cannot prove mobile framing or user-view readability.
visible_findings.next_correction: Keep the historical file and add a newly framed actualGLB capture. Coordinator has announced a new instruments-18-baseline with inspecteurv2, without a source edit; not yet visually reviewed in this audit.

visible_findings.observation: Related photos show visibly toothed/striped centre bands. In the candidate close-up the bands read mainly as smooth changes of brightness; individual tooth detail is not legible.
visible_findings.not_claimed: This lighting-dependent capture does not prove absent geometry or a wrong tooth pitch/depth. Much of each band will also be hidden by separate clamps.
visible_findings.next_correction: Use a controlled grazing-light proof of the existing geometry before changing any band relief. This is lower visual priority than the instrument cap/dial details.

handlebar_shape_disposition.reason: The isolated related photographs have different uncalibrated oblique poses. The official close-up crops/occludes much of the tube. Those views do not justify a specific new change to rise, sweep, width, bend radius or tube diameter.
handlebar_shape_disposition.presentation_limit: The currentcockpit.png crops both outer ends;quarter.png does show the entire isolated tube. Do not treat the cropped cockpit view alone as a full-silhouette proof.
handlebar_shape_disposition.not_accepted: Lack of a proven specific error is not shape, dimension or exactRDC acceptance.

engine_view_limit.observation: Existing Babylon glass reflections still veil part of the dial. This is relevant to user readability but is an optical/lighting issue, not evidence to deform the dial or case.
engine_view_limit.next_action: Judge revised baseline readability separately from silhouette and avoid copying reflected photographic highlights into textures.

separate_technical_reserve.reported_observation: Strict inspection of the actual instrumentsGLB found8 exactly zero-area triangles. Coordinator is localising mesh/source without modifying frozen model.
separate_technical_reserve.implication: Do not describe this export as having passed the new strict geometric preflight. The reserve is separate from the visible shape differences and from the empty historical mobile image.
separate_technical_reserve.future_action: Preserve frozen candidate and attach coordinator diagnosis/new proof to any future correction revision.

documentary_limits: Official photograph is published on theRDC125HD page but asset filename containsBM150. Exact assembly part/year/VIN remains unknown.
RelatedDU181021 handlebar photos do not certify currentRDC identity, dimensions or independent photographic authorship.

The Motoshed file is currently a usable1512x1512 JPEG of65933bytes; its actualSHA is recorded here. The old empty-fileSHA in handlebar/reference-observations.json is historical and not used as proof of this current photo.
Source construction dimensions, unobserved backs, hidden mount interfaces and camera placement remain estimates.
No absent visor, mirrors, ignition, bracket or controls are charged as a defect of these deliberately isolated component scopes.

USB_2D_handoff.method: Manual native-pixel reading after6x display enlargement of crop425,325,550,435; enlarged view contains no extra detail. Outer boundary reading±5px, capsule/lip±3px, symbol±3px.
USB_2D_handoff.part_segmentation_not_confirmed: Visible nested boundaries do not establish moulded-part count, exact rubber/material split or hinge/socket mechanics.
USB_2D_handoff.curve_use: Traceable image-space landmark suggestions, not closed exactCAD curves or proof of camera/part dimensions. Keep original private image visible when refining.
USB_2D_handoff.depths_and_interfaces: Unknown; any lip inset, cap convexity, wall thickness or attachment mechanics must stay bounded estimates.
